title: An open question offers only a quiet link
problem: The state that most needs a next step has the weakest control, and that link does three different things.
fix: Make it the primary button, named for what it does: Focus in Midna or Reopen to answer. With the owner's OK, a field with Send answer as the primary takes its place.

title: The banner sends the owner to Midna for a task with no terminal
problem: The first line points the wrong way, repeats the box and pushes Done down.
fix: Show no banner on a human task unless there's a real question.

title: A pull request has no single next action
problem: Mark reviewed, Terminal, Merge and status links all look alike, so nothing reads as the move to make.
fix: Put the owner's action first in one box, with the step list under it.

title: The pull request link sits below the actions
problem: The panel orders it mark reviewed, merge, then open. At the smallest window the link is out of view.
fix: Add Open PR to the owner's row, before Mark reviewed.

title: Looks finished recommends restarting the task
problem: The banner lists signs the work is done, yet Resume is the primary, the box is alarm red, and Mark done only starts a terminal.
fix: Put the finish action first and call it Check and finish. Use a calm green box, and make Resume plain.

title: Empty future rows come before Now
problem: Three rows with no data take about 180px above the Now card, half the body at the smallest window.
fix: Until a pull request exists, replace them with one quiet line under Now saying what comes next.

title: The tab row moves and doesn't mark the selected tab
problem: Timeline disappears while selected, so labels jump 72px, and hover looks the same as selected.
fix: Move the tabs to the top of the panel, always draw all four, mark the selected one with an accent bar and weight, and keep hover different.

title: Tabs, close, menus and dialogs can't be reached from the keyboard
problem: Only text fields take focus, so every other control in the panel needs a pointer.
fix: Add tab stops and a visible focus ring, arrow keys in tabs and menus, and focus inside dialogs.

title: The step row runs off the panel
problem: With six steps the last one reads Merg and To d, and a seventh is out of view.
fix: Draw a vertical list, one row per step, in every state.

title: Primary buttons fail contrast in dark
problem: White on the dark blue is 4.22:1, under the 4.5:1 this text size needs, on every main action.
fix: Change the dark button blue to #4166ea: 4.87:1 with white, and still 3.40:1 against the card.

title: Closed-terminal banners don't say what happened or when
problem: Five headings share the agent's last progress line, which reads as current activity, and a Waiting on you line with no data follows.
fix: Lead with what happened and the time, then the last update as small text. Drop the Waiting on you line.

title: Orange also marks work that isn't the owner's
problem: Agent work and merge steps use the colour that means the owner must act.
fix: Keep orange for what the owner must do, and name the actor elsewhere, such as Agent next.

title: Step text and rings fail contrast
problem: Step names are how the owner follows a pull request, yet not-started and passed labels measure 3.04:1 and 4.38:1, and the empty ring 1.48:1.
fix: Use the muted and darker green text colours, and a stronger ring.

title: May be stuck offers no action
problem: It's the only warning with no button, and Focus in Midna sits far down the timeline.
fix: While the terminal is live, add Focus in Midna as the primary, with Close terminal in a menu beside it.

title: A stopped pull request contradicts itself
problem: The banner says the fix stopped, the row below says it's still fixing, and six moves compete.
fix: Make the banner the one call to action, word the row Fix stopped, and hide Merge while the conflict stands.

title: Merge now shows when it can't work
problem: It's offered on stacked pull requests, on open conflicts and while a merge is already running.
fix: Hide it in those states, move it to the pull request's menu as Merge anyway…, and name what it skips in the dialog.

title: A blocked task looks ready to do
problem: One small line is the only difference, and Done stays live.
fix: Use the quiet box, link the task it waits on, and disable Done.

title: Done can't be taken back, and takes an empty note
problem: A slip sends agents on without the values they asked for, and nothing reopens it.
fix: Ask once when the steps want a note, and add Reopen on the done box. Both need the owner's OK.

title: The steps say note, and nothing on screen is called one
problem: The steps ask for values in the note, but no label says which field that is.
fix: Add a visible Note for the agents label and the same accessible name. The visible label needs the owner's OK.

title: Esc closes the panel, not the open menu
problem: With the terminal menu or Attached open, Esc closes the whole panel.
fix: Close the top overlay first, and clear all three when the panel closes.

title: Closing a busy dialog throws away its result
problem: The request carries on, but the toast, any failure and the refresh are lost.
fix: Hold the dialog until the answer arrives, or show the result as a toast either way.

title: The confirm repeats the title, not what the action does
problem: Merge now names neither the pull request's title nor what it skips.
fix: Add one line of live data, such as the title and Skips: your review.

title: Banner buttons wrap around a disabled Reopen
problem: Three buttons never fit the panel, and Reopen, even when disabled, pushes a real option to a second row.
fix: Leave Reopen out when no conversation was saved, and shorten it to Reopen conversation.

title: One action goes by several names
problem: Resume, start and send each have two or three labels across banners.
fix: Use one name each: Resume in a new terminal, Try again, Send answer.

title: Option buttons hide what a click will do
problem: The same button sends at once, picks one or picks several.
fix: Add a round or square mark when a Send follows, so a plain option means it sends.

title: The answer field has no name, and empty Send complains late
problem: Nothing says what the field is for, and Send only objects after the click.
fix: Give the field an accessible name, with no visible placeholder, and disable Send until there's text.

title: A question on a human task can lose its result
problem: The sent or failed note and any alert have nowhere to show.
fix: Let the human-task banner show both, as the other banners do.

title: Waits on steps hides who it waits on
problem: The board's own phase word appears, and one wait is worded three ways.
fix: Say Waits on you, or name the first open step.

title: The blocking pull request can't be opened
problem: Its number is plain text, though the sibling lines link.
fix: Send its link with the data and draw it like Stacks on.

title: Reviewer rows mislead on time and look like labels
problem: Asked 7:12 AM reads as when changes were asked, and names look unclickable until hovered.
fix: Show Asked only while waiting, with a date, and underline names at rest.

title: Merged without a note is a dead end
problem: An orange Waiting offers no action and names nobody.
fix: Reword it and link the terminal when there is one. A Write the note signal needs the owner's OK.

title: Links and the field edge are faint on the orange box
problem: The link is 4.45:1, and the field edge 1.55:1 against the box.
fix: Use the darker link blue, and a field edge of at least 3:1.

title: Done is out of view at the smallest window
problem: The fold cuts through the note, and long steps do the same at any size.
fix: Remove the banner and duplicate link, then pin Done and Talk it over to the bottom of the panel.

title: Numbered steps aren't drawn as a list
problem: Wrapped lines return under the numbers, so finding your place again is slow.
fix: Draw a numbered list with a hanging indent and a small gap between steps.

title: The link button repeats the step, and the two exits look swapped
problem: The same address appears twice, and Talk it over looks like a link.
fix: Drop the button when a step already links it, and give Talk it over a border.

title: The panel stays 480px and covers the page
problem: Wide windows leave empty page while filters still wrap, and page content sits hidden under the panel.
fix: Grow it with the window up to 640px, and reserve its space from 1200px wide.

title: A long title squeezes the body
problem: A five-line title takes the fixed header to nearly half the smallest window.
fix: Limit it to two lines with a tooltip when cut, and show it whole on the brief.

title: 2 of 4 has no label and looks like a button
problem: The sidebar's 1 of 4 means something else, and a done task keeps an alert-coloured chip.
fix: Write Task 2 of 4 as plain muted text, and keep fills for controls.

title: Close has no name or tooltip
problem: The back button beside it has one, and this one doesn't.
fix: Name it Close, with the Esc shortcut in the tooltip.

title: Agent text in the Now card shows raw markdown
problem: Asterisks show as written, and one long update can fill the body.
fix: Draw it the way notes are drawn, and limit it to four lines with Show all.

title: Timeline times carry no date
problem: A task started last week reads like today.
fix: Prefix Yesterday or the day, and add the full time as a tooltip.

title: The Full log count is faint and outside the tab
problem: It measures 3.04:1, and clicking it does nothing.
fix: Use the muted colour and draw the count inside the tab.

title: What to do holds the agent's brief
problem: The name promises what the owner should do, and the tab shows the agent's instructions.
fix: Rename the tab Brief.

title: Context has edit controls the read-only rule doesn't allow
problem: Details has editable fields, and Bits has Mark created.
fix: Draw Details as plain rows. Keeping Mark created or editing needs the owner's OK.

title: Branch and commit facts differ between tabs
problem: Timeline and Context read different sources, so one can show a commit the other doesn't.
fix: Work out the last commit once, and show these facts in Context only.

title: Seven log filters always wrap
problem: They take two rows at every size, some are empty, and some names don't match the rows.
fix: Use one Show pop-up with counts, and rename the kinds to match.

title: The log's helper sentence is filler
problem: It shows no data and repeats on every task.
fix: Delete it.

title: The log filter probably carries over to the next task
problem: A filter set on one task can hide rows on the next.
fix: Reset the filter when the task changes.

title: Attached stays open across tasks and after use
problem: The next task can open with its dropdown already covering the timeline.
fix: Reset it on task change, close it on an outside click, and close it after a row opens.

title: Attached is placed by a fixed offset
problem: When the chips wrap, the dropdown covers its own chip.
fix: Anchor it to the chip, inside the window.

title: Task and goal attachments are mixed in one list
problem: The owner can't tell what belongs to this task.
fix: Put a heading above each owner's rows, and indent the rows under it.

title: Close terminal takes effect at once with no undo
problem: On a failed task, the terminal may be the best record of why.
fix: Ask first on failed tasks and force closes, which needs the owner's OK. Without that, show its last output in the Failed step.

title: Menu helper text repeats the label and can be false
problem: Stops the command that is running shows even when nothing runs.
fix: Remove the line, or show real data such as Idle 12m.

title: An empty reviewer popover says the same thing twice
problem: 0 open and No open reviews fill the card.
fix: Collapse the card to the name and the count.

title: The reviewer popover doesn't fit the smallest window
problem: Its list is taller than a 560px window allows.
fix: Set the list height from the window.

title: Reviewer and attachment lists aren't virtualized
problem: Every row is built up front, which breaks the owner's rule for long lists.
fix: Use the virtualized list the log already uses.

title: The reviewer popover has no retry
problem: A failed load shows the raw backend message with nothing to press.
fix: Use a plain message with Try again, and show Updating while it refreshes.

title: Menu hover is nearly invisible
problem: Hover measures 1.08:1 against the menu, and rows with no link react too.
fix: Add a stronger hover colour, and use it only on rows that do something.

title: Dialogs draw smaller than coded and sit off-centre
problem: The Note dialog ends mid-line with no scrollbar or fade, so nothing says there's more.
fix: Set the size limits once on the dialog's outer frame, let the box shrink inside it, and show a scrollbar on long notes.

title: A failed attempt removes the button
problem: A dropped connection looks final, so there's no retry.
fix: Keep the button as Try again for errors, and change the title for final results.

title: A confirm opened from a terminal link can show only a task number
problem: Cancel T6? can sit over another task's panel with no title.
fix: Fetch the task first, and keep the button disabled until it arrives.

title: Stuck heading repeats the title in capitals
problem: The heading restates the task number and title just above it.
fix: Use May be stuck as the heading, and fix the mid-sentence capital.

title: Banner links start off the left edge
problem: Two links keep button padding and use two different styles.
fix: Align them to the banner text and use one link style.

title: Note preview counts source lines
problem: One long paragraph shows in full, with no Show all.
fix: Limit the preview to three drawn lines.

title: Merged doesn't say when
problem: Started has a time, and Merged has none.
fix: Show the merge time, if the board has it.

title: The finished record has no time or steps
problem: Checking back later shows only the note.
fix: Add the finish time, and put the steps in a closed fold.

title: The Now line has an unlabelled number
problem: It isn't clear that 3m is run time.
fix: Write Running 3m.

title: The least-used Context block has the most emphasis
problem: A long prompt the owner rarely needs gets the only tint and blue heading.
fix: Use the neutral box and muted heading.

title: A tooltip sits on the open menu
problem: The ⋯ button shows no open state, and the Attached chevron never flips.
fix: Hide the tooltip while open, and show the open state.

title: The busy button still looks clickable
problem: It keeps the pointer cursor and the hover fill.
fix: Use the app's usual disabled button look.

title: The way out sits apart from the action
problem: Close is small and in the heading row, so the pair doesn't read as a choice.
fix: Put Keep task or Not now beside the action.
